plan: DUMMIE PLAN V1 — Cognitive Evolution Operating Layer

claims: Folder-level compression is required for repeatable global orientation without raw-folder scans.
FolderNotes must remain derived to avoid overriding canonical truth sources.
P10 requires deterministic source-hash hooks from P9 outputs.
objections: Notes can become stale narrative debt without freshness governance.
Dependency-heavy folders can distort architecture summaries.
Coverage linkage can drift if not tracked with invalidation triggers.
decisions: Limit scope to tier-0 folders only.
Default token role to summary_only for all generated notes.
Attach source hash and refresh triggers per folder entry.
risks: Freshness drift remains until P10 detector is active.
Dependency-heavy folders require continued classification hardening.
Inherited legacy spec debt remains open and warning-scoped.

snowball_assessment.reason: P9 adds governed compression artifacts with freshness and truth controls instead of ad-hoc narrative notes.

warnings: Freshness enforcement runtime remains deferred to P10.
